pull.title: rpc: Correct invalid OpenRPC defaults
pull.body:
`getopenrpcinfo` emits two defaults that do not satisfy their schemas.

This changes `getdeploymentinfo.blockhash` to a default hint, since its fallback describes the current chain tip, and makes `send.options.include_watching` default to boolean `false`.

author will <will@256k1.dev> 1789759375 +0100
committer will <will@256k1.dev> 1789800652 +0100

rpc: Mark deployment blockhash default as a hint...

...and use a boolean OpenRPC default for send.

The fallback text describes how an omitted blockhash is resolved. It is
not a valid hash and should not appear as a JSON Schema default.

Emit it as a Bitcoin-specific hint so schema validators do not treat the
prose as a permissible blockhash.

The include_watching option is declared as boolean, but its string
default makes the generated schema internally inconsistent. Use the
boolean value already used by the analogous sendall option.
